task_0.name: task_0
task_0.description: Infer the circuit topology and resistor values from node-to-node resistance measurements.
task_0.submission_format: JSON string with circuit topology (e.g., {"resistors": {"R1": x, ...}, "connections": [["A","B","R1"], ...]})

notes: Assume ideal resistors; treat measurements as exact within ±0.1 ohm.
The resistances are labeled from left to right as R1, R2, R3, ..., etc.
